modifications: Dot-product helpers: mlx2's QMV_HEADER (float input sums, as the venv MLX fork 39400a0d4 does) instead of omlx's verbatim 0.32.2 header.

qmv_fast_layout keys only on K alignment for affine weights: the venv fork runs N % 8 != 0 outputs on the fast traversal (affine_qmv_fast_rows). omlx's N-keyed rule picked the qmv traversal for the 1-column shared_expert_gate and 4-column hc.inject and differed from the one-row call (1 element at 16 rows, GPU 2026-09-30).

MAX_ROWS 32 (covers the 17-row copy-draft window); OneRowQmv/RowsQmv/grouped launches not carried; a declined layout or a non-Metal device runs one stock one-row call per row and reports route per_row.

The omlx route is a monkey-patch of mlx-vlm/mlx-lm; mlx2 installs instance-scoped class swaps on the loaded trunk (QuantizedLinear, Attention, MoE block) that act only inside a verify window opened by Model.mtp_verify_backbone/mtp_verify_logits.

Attention rows: per-row one-token QSA forwards with the ordinary B=1 mask instead of omlx's 2-row vector SDPA chunks / fused attention rows. MoE: per-row one-token block instead of omlx's fused window (wave 2). GDN: mlx2's existing fused verify kernel, Metal-checked bit-identical to sequential one-token fused decode at 2..17 rows incl. rollback; omlx needed a q/k L2 fix that mlx2's kernel does not.

Fail closed: per-window stage accounting; a GDN layer that leaves the fused verify, a shared-suffix QSA row, a fused QSA projection table, a pre-selected or batched attention call marks the window not row-exact; receipts say row_exact only when no window since the request began fell back.
No Apple copyright header is added.

Grouped launch (_group_source/_group_kernel/quantized_linears) used for the attention q/k/v/index_qk and GDN qkv/z/b/a projections; MoE: router gate and shared expert batched through the kernel, routed experts per row.
